## Mo ta tinh nang

Mo ta ro rang tinh nang ban muon de xuat.

## Ly do

Giai thich tai sao tinh nang nay can thiet hoac huu ich.

## Giai phap de xuat

Mo ta cach ban nghi tinh nang nen hoat dong.

## Thiet ke (neu co)

Them mockup, wireframe, hoac mo ta giao dien.

## Pham vi anh huong

- [ ] Domain layer (entities, usecases)
- [ ] Data layer (repositories, services)
- [ ] Presentation layer (UI, providers)
- [ ] Core (constants, utils)

## Thong tin them

Them bat ky thong tin nao khac.
